urlContentMap.additionalContent: At Caliber Collision, it’s our privilege to serve drivers across the great state of California with quality collision repair services backed by a limited lifetime warranty. From Los Angeles to San Diego, San Francisco to Sacramento, our certified body shops are here to get you back on the road as efficiently as possible. We work with the largest insurance providers, use state-of-the-art technology, and are I-CAR Gold Class certified, meeting the highest industry standards for training and auto repair excellence.
